name: A scorched smell in the service bay
notes: Played by FS47Attention (S47Attention.cpp, N1110) with the mains taken (FS47FreeformSession::SkyCutBegin): the standby generator rides it, and the mains come back.

beats.text: The whole place smells like a struck match.
At {clock} the mains sagged and went with no storm and no fault on the feeder. Afterward the transfer panel smelled scorched, like a struck match.
